analyst.summary: Archean Chemical is India's largest bromine and industrial-salt exporter, with genuinely strong returns on capital even though profit has declined this year as bromine prices have normalized from their 2022-23 highs. The company is investing in new bromine-derivative, energy-storage and semiconductor-material capacity that could support renewed growth, but near-term earnings remain under pressure during this capex ramp-up, so we see this as a hold rather than a name to add to right now.
